description: restore_snapshot rejects a unilevel snapshot whose index names a slot past the end of nodes, with INCONSISTENT_SNAPSHOT. Cross-language lock for the HEU-706 restore trust boundary. Paired with the undeserializable restore fixture in this directory: together they prove the two codes are told apart, not just that one of them fires. The payload spells out the Arena shape by hand, so a new required field on Arena or Node turns this into a deserialization failure rather than the rejection it tests.

error.message_contains: to node slot 99; the arena holds
